editorialReview.arm: Expanded cue contains the complete gesture; subject matte bounds the replacement silhouette.
editorialReview.foreground: Original woman and her raised metal forearm are protected by a separate tracked subject.
editorialReview.limitation: The generated head turn still follows the driver less closely.

character.scope: Local fictional human replacement; source woman and surrounding scene retained.

matte.operation: Union source and generated replacement subjects, dilate 2px and feather 0.8px; subtract protected subjects with a 1px guard.

castle.method: Low-frequency correction from the spatial boundary before temporal fades. Generated detail is retained; zero-alpha source pixels are preserved before resizing and encoding.

transitions.method: Integer-index PyAV picture joins; independent 48kHz audio joins. A moving-bar test checks every frame through two dissolves and an intervening cut, including EOF.

limitations: The generated character head turn follows the source incompletely.
SAM masks require reviewed annotations; this is not one-click arbitrary character replacement.
This is not full Higgsfield feature parity or evidence of general generation quality.
submission: Not submitted; Jay reviews and submits.
